user.title: Set up OnTrac
user.description: OnTrac tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `ontrac.track_parcel` service.

data_description.tracking_codes: Add or remove codes from this list. You find an OnTrac tracking code on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.
data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like an OnTrac tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its OnTrac tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its OnTrac tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The OnTrac tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
